headlines.t: BoE Gov. Bailey: Businesses still say it is hard to pass on cost increases.
BoE Gov. Bailey: The risk premium in interest rates futures reflects uncertainty about energy prices, not about the BoE policy response.
BoE Gov. Bailey: It is more likely than not that we will have to raise interest rates more if energy prices stay elevated.
BoE's Mann: The optimal response is to hike rates more and sooner.
BoE's Dhingra: I'm surprised by how little pass-through there has been of higher energy prices compared to 2022.
BoE Gov. Bailey: The UK labour market is no longer softening; it has flattened out.
BoE Gov. Bailey: We are seeing greater resilience in the UK economy; we must factor this into inflation projections.
BoE Gov. Bailey: The pipeline of energy effects now looks stronger.
